description: Use only right after the signed-in LAWYER said yes to the exact text shown by preview_office_reply. Sends exactly that text, once, into the person's private ESQ CoPilot thread. Refused for staff, for a changed draft, after 15 minutes, or if the inbox is off. Report the status exactly as returned (sent means stored in the person's thread, not read). For a lawyer or staff member of a law office signed in to ESQ CoPilot for their office. Do not call it for a person looking for a lawyer (use search_attorneys) or for general legal questions.
